gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Pure monoline swagger: Oxanium never lets its stroke thicken or thin, and its big lowercase curves finish in clear daylight. Noto Sans Deseret follows with a squat, friendly sans of low contrast.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Oxanium draws everything with one fixed nib. It does display punch best, with a big lowercase, while Noto Sans Elbasan, a sans-serif, does quiet text best with open terminals that never pinch.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi is a contemporary sans-serif whose lowercase fills the line almost like capitals. But Oxanium does monoline display punch best, where the text face does quiet reading best.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-puritan: Monoline swagger from Oxanium, with an outsized lowercase. Commanding display is its job, while Puritan, a plain sans, gives soft rounded text oversized e and a counters.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic: Loose, swaggering letters, scattered wide by Paprika. Loud display is its strength, while Carrois Gothic, a plain sans, does tidy modern text with a generous opening in its c.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Commanding and loose, Paprika scatters its letters wide. Carrois Gothic SC, a plain sans, sits quietly beside it, with curves open at every end and lowercase nearly capital height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Scattered letters, hollow-reed counters, loud swagger. Paprika does swagger best, while Noto Sans Kannada, a plain sans, does gentle text best with s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with counters like a cut reed, above Noto Sans Tamil, a sans that looks magnified. Loud up top, terminals held far from the stem below.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans gives crisp, wide-mouthed sans-serif text that stays sharp when shrunk, its lowercase rising close to capitals. Long paragraphs should glide along smoothly beneath the loud Paprika heading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-prompt: Loud, scattered, hollow-reed swagger: that is Paprika all over. Display swagger is its strength, while Prompt, a plain sans, handles readable text with oversized small letters and open apertures.
